pelt_policy: Keep 12h minimum segment; no split is possible below 24h. No invented history.
comparison: Non-overlapping blocks of the same 336-hour monitor sequences; all original hourly labels retained
calibration: Normal train statistics; normal calibration floor plus maximum normal-development per-scenario quantile; no test threshold selection
test_status: Reuse of the previously reported long-series test set; this is a horizon ablation, NOT a new independent blind test
missingness: Interpolate short missing runs within each batch only; split at >6h gaps; never inspect another batch
reference_updates: Fixed reviewed normal reference; monitoring data are never silently added to normal history
evaluation_unit: assessable hour, not any-anomaly-per-batch; no point adjustment
